[DOCKET REVIEW REQUEST · docket.review_requested·object.slug "docket.review_requested·object.title"] You are named as the REVIEWER of this docket item. THIS IS NOT OWNERSHIP: docket.review_requested·owner keeps the work and the responsibility for delivering it. You hold exactly three things — read it, add `evidence`, and record ONE decision with orgtree_work action='review': `approve` (the check passed — that COMPLETES the item) or `changes` (it goes back to the owner as in_progress, and your note is what they act on). Until you decide, the next action on this item is yours.
Requested by docket.review_requested·requested_by.
